name: Houseboat Harmony
niche_feature: Single bed-and-breakfast guest room aboard a houseboat (woonboot) moored on the river Vecht in Utrecht; the only bookable unit is on the boat.
evidence_quote: Slapen in een Bed and Breakfast kamer in Utrecht op een woonboot met prachtig uitzicht op de Vecht
reason: Official site confirms the one guest room is on a houseboat on the Vecht; category correct.

name: MS Fram Expedition Ship
niche_feature: Purpose-built polar expedition cruise ship (HX Expeditions) for 200 guests; all cabins and suites are aboard the vessel. A sailing voyage, not a moored stay.
evidence_quote: Purpose-built as an expedition cruise ship, MS Fram is an exceptional base camp for explorers.
reason: Guests sleep aboard a ship afloat; closest of the 14 categories is floating-hotels, though it is an expedition cruise rather than a moored stay.
page_issues: Operator is now HX Expeditions (page says Hurtigruten's)
Official capacity is 200 guests; '16 specialist guides', 3,000 polar bears and polar bear encounter claims are not supported by the source
Rating 9.2 / 1,876 reviews and 'polar hot tub' not confirmed by the source (official mentions hot tub and Science Centre)
It is a cruise voyage, not a fixed-location hotel; Svalbard is one itinerary among several

name: OFF Paris Seine
niche_feature: Floating hotel moored at the foot of Gare d'Austerlitz: 54 ship-cabin-style rooms plus 4 suites, rooms on the Seine; lowest-level rooms sit at water level.
evidence_quote: le OFF Paris Seine, le premier hôtel flottant sur la Seine
reason: Press source and official site describe a moored floating hotel with all rooms aboard; official site itself never says 'floating' or 'barge'.
page_issues: 'Paris's only floating hotel' unsupported; sources say 'first' floating hotel
Inaugurated '2017' conflicts with press saying it opened in 2016
Rooftop deck, weathered steel and timber exterior, Parisian architects and Notre-Dame view upstream are not confirmed by the sources
Official describes rooms, dining bar and pool; official site says Gare d'Austerlitz/Gare de Lyon location (13th arrondissement), not 5th

name: Schwimmendes Haus
niche_feature: Self-catering two-storey floating house on the Partwitzer See for 2 to 3 guests, available all year; described as the first floating house on the lake.
evidence_quote: Das erste „Schwimmende Haus“ auf dem Partwitzer See lädt ganzjährig zum Urlaub auf dem Wasser ein.
reason: Official page confirms a house that floats on the lake and is rented for overnight stays.
page_issues: Official page says one extra bed can be added for 20 EUR per night; capacity 2 to 3 confirmed

name: The Harpy Houseboat
niche_feature: Moored 1904 houseboat (ex-HMS Harpy) on the Thames, let as a whole four-bedroom floating home sleeping up to 12 in 4 cabins.
evidence_quote: transformed into a spectacular 1,850 sq ft (172 sq m) four-bedroom floating home
reason: Official site confirms a moored houseboat holiday let; category correct.
page_issues: Official site says both 'moored just west of Tower Bridge' and 'relocated to the South Bank, 400m east of Tower Bridge' (address China Wharf, Mill Street SE1 2BB); page repeats only 'west'
Page says 'four rooms'; official says four-bedroom, 4 cabins, sleeps up to 12
'London's number one Airbnb' is the operator quoting Time Out Jan 2025, presented as the site's own claim

name: Archipelago Igloos
niche_feature: Glass igloo accommodation unit(s): floating in summer, anchored between Vallisaari and Kuninkaansaari; in winter the glass igloos are in the Sipoo archipelago. Number of units and ice setting not confirmed (official site bot-walled).
evidence_quote: Summer season our floating accommodation units are anchored at the bay between Vallisaari and Kuninkaansaari.
reason: Not an ice hotel: glass igloos, floating in summer. Best fit is bubble-hotels (glass igloos); floating-hotels is the alternative.
page_issues: Filed under ice-hotels but nothing says it is made of ice or snow
Official site blocked by bot challenge; one unit, 4 May to 30 October season, floor-to-ceiling glass and kitchen/toilet details not verified from a citable source
Winter 'on the ice' location is Sipoo archipelago per Visit Finland

name: Arctic Guesthouse & Igloos
niche_feature: Glass igloos (AuroraHut, ideally for 2 people) on the shore of Lake Ranua, some able to float and move under electric engine in summer; the property also has ordinary guesthouse rooms and Aurora Lake Lodges.
evidence_quote: Arctic glass igloo resort in Finland: Our compact igloos offer immersive experience ideally for 2 people.
reason: Glass igloos, not ice rooms; ice-hotels is wrong. Only the igloos fit; guesthouse rooms and lodges are ordinary.
page_issues: Filed under ice-hotels but nothing is made of ice or snow; these are glass igloos
'Ten movable glass igloos' count and 'Wi-Fi in every igloo' not stated on the official igloos page
Official page says the AuroraHut igloos float and move on the lake in summer, not merely 'movable'

name: ICEHOTEL 365
niche_feature: Ice rooms and art suites in ICEHOTEL Winter (Dec-Apr), plus ICEHOTEL 365 year-round art and deluxe suites made of ice and snow (18 suites, -5C); warm rooms and cabins in separate buildings are ordinary.
evidence_quote: All suites in ICEHOTEL 365 are exclusively designed, and made entirely from ice and snow.
reason: Ice rooms and suites confirmed; but only the ice suites are niche, warm rooms and cabins are also offered.
page_issues: Official says 'open every year since 1989' (page: since 1990)
Official says 18 art and deluxe suites in ICEHOTEL 365 (page: 20)
'World's only permanent ice hotel' contradicted: official says 'world's first year-round ice hotel' and Snow Resort Kirkenes claims a 365 hotel too
'Most iconic cold-weather accommodation on Earth' superlative unsupported

name: SnowCastle of Kemi
niche_feature: Snow hotel is no longer built; the area offers a SnowExperience exhibition room, SnowCastle Winter Park (Jan-early April), icebreaker cruises, and year-round Seaside Glass Villas as accommodation.
evidence_quote: No we do not have the Snow Hotel at the moment. We have the all-year-round accommodation in the Seaside Glass Villas.
reason: Official FAQ says there is no snow hotel at the moment; the traditional snow castle was replaced by year-round services and ordinary glass villas.
page_issues: Describes snow hotel rooms and a rebuilt-every-winter castle; official FAQ says 'The traditional castle built from snow has been replaced by year-round services' and no snow hotel exists now
Hotel rooms, snow restaurant and chapel inside the castle not offered per official FAQ
Accommodation is now the Seaside Glass Villas, not 'warm hotel accommodation adjacent'
'Largest snow castle', 13-14 m height superlatives unsupported

name: Snowhotel Kirkenes
niche_feature: Snowhotel 365: snow-and-ice suites, kept frozen year-round, at Snow Resort Kirkenes (Bjørnevatn); resort also has warm Gamme cabins as ordinary accommodation.
evidence_quote: Welcome to the world's only hotel made entirely of snow and ice that’s open year-round for overnight stays.
reason: Snow-and-ice hotel confirmed by official site; only the snow suites are niche, cabins are ordinary.
page_issues: Page says carved anew each winter; official says Snowhotel 365 is cooled and open year-round
Now trades as Snow Resort Kirkenes / Snowhotel 365
Site 'in the birch woodland outside the city', annual commissioned artist murals and ice bar not confirmed by the source
Official says original hotel had eight rooms in 2006, none of the page's room details verified

name: Sorrisniva Igloo Hotel
niche_feature: Igloo Hotel of ice and snow rebuilt every winter (Dec 20 to Mar 31) with igloo rooms, family rooms and themed suites; the separate Arctic Wilderness Lodge offers ordinary warm rooms.
evidence_quote: The Igloo Hotel is rebuilt every winter, featuring a blend of unique igloo rooms and themed suites.
reason: Seasonal ice hotel confirmed; ice rooms are the niche, lodge accommodation is separate and ordinary. Open Dec 20 to Mar 31 each winter.
page_issues: Official says 'second of its kind'; page says 'Norway's original' / first, built since 2000 not confirmed
Page says built each November and December; official says open Dec 20 to Mar 31
Adjacent Alta Museum claim unsupported
Official gives 2,500 m2, 250 tonnes of ice; page's room temperatures and sleeping-bag ratings not confirmed

name: Cristalino Lodge
niche_feature: Lodge of air-conditioned bungalows (Special Bungalow, Bungalow, Junior Bungalow, Superior Suite) inside the Cristalino RPPN private rainforest reserve in the southern Amazon, near Alta Floresta; a separate Wilderness Camp of tents also exists.
evidence_quote: Situated close to the River Cristalino, within a huge forest reserve covering an area of 11,399 hectares
reason: Official site confirms a lodge within a large Amazon rainforest reserve; jungle-lodges category correct.
page_issues: Reserve is 11,399 hectares per official site, page says 1,100
Page says 'simple wooden rooms with mosquito nets... nothing remotely luxurious'; official lists air-conditioned bungalows of 53-79 m2 with private gardens and outdoor baths
Pioneer since 1999, 600+ birds, 50 m tower and night boat safaris not confirmed on pages read
